advisories.dependencyPath: riteway 9.3.0 (devDependency of every testing workspace) > vitest 3.2.7 > @vitest/mocker 3.2.7. better-auth lists vitest only as an optional peer, so riteway is what installs it.
advisories.reason: Path traversal in @vitest/mocker's redirect mock (moderate). Fixed in vitest 4.1.11, but riteway 9.x hard-depends on vitest ^3.2.4 for its riteway/vitest entry.
advisories.unreachable: Dev-only and never loaded: Daisy's tests run on bun:test through riteway/bun, nothing imports riteway/vitest, vitest or better-auth/test, and no production image installs dev dependencies.

advisories.reason: Unbounded recursion in _.flatten and _.isEqual, a denial of service (high). Fixed in underscore 1.13.8, which jsonpath's exact pin excludes.
advisories.unreachable: Only @adobe/data's schema/dynamic modules import jsonpath. Daisy imports @adobe/data/ecs alone (packages/debate-engine/src/ecs-adapter.ts), whose module graph contains neither jsonpath nor underscore.

advisories.dependencyPath: eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces 3.0.3 (devDependency of apps/web).
advisories.reason: Stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns, a denial of service (high). Every published braces release, 3.0.3 included, is affected; no patched version exists yet.
advisories.unreachable: Dev-only: braces is reached only through eslint-config-next's lint tooling, which globs Daisy's own source files and never parses untrusted input, and no production image installs dev dependencies.

advisories.reason: Prototype pollution gadget in worker options leading to remote code execution (critical). Fixed in tinypool 2.1.1, but vitest 3.x pins tinypool ^1 and riteway 9.x hard-depends on vitest ^3.2.4.
